new.text: 7.2.4.15 RTE Implementation Plug-In Lifecycle API RTE Implementation Plug-Ins might need initialization in the same way the RTE might need it. Consequently, there will be init/deinit and start/stop APIs, which the RTE has to call. As the RTE’s lifecycle APIs will be called on every core, also the RTE Implementation Plug-In’s lifecycle APIs will do so. [SWS_Rte_70047] Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00101, SRS_BSW_00336, SRS_Rte_00306, SRS_Rte_- 00304 ⌈The RTE Implementation Plug-In shall always provide the Lifecycle APIs Rte_Rips_SchM_Init, Rte_Rips_Rte_Start, Rte_Rips_Rte_Stop, and Rte_Rips_SchM_Deinit.⌋ [SWS_Rte_80055] Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00101, SRS_BSW_00336, SRS_Rte_00306, SRS_Rte_- 00304 ⌈The RTE shall call the Lifecycle APIs of all participating RTE Implementation Plug-Ins in the order given by index of the RteRipsPluginConfigurationRefs.⌋
